title: When the Crown Wakes
author: S. M. Kavanagh
blurb: Oscar Joubert, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
